metadata.case_name: KO CHI KEI v. FUNING PROPERTY MANAGEMENT LTD

injuries.description: fracture of his right os calcis (also known as the calcaneum)
source: He was found to have suffered from a fracture of his right os calcis (also known as the calcaneum).

manifestations.description: right ankle pain at rest and at night
pain at the change of weather
after walking, he would experience further pain
pins and needles over his right foot after walking
He can no longer stand on the right foot alone
persistent stiffness and pain of right ankle
discomfort, difficulty in excessive weight bearing including activities such as prolonged standing and walking, particularly for walking up and down stairs
not suitable for vigorous sport activities
sleeps badly because he would experience pain at night

treatments_received: sent to the Tuen Mun Hospital by ambulance soon after the accident
operation of open reduction and fixation to stabilise his ankle with plate and nails on 31 May 2008
implants in his right ankle were removed on 7 August 2007
47 sessions of physiotherapy between 16 August 2005 and 4 April 2006
follow-up treatments at the Department of Orthopaedics at Tuen Mun Hospital

losses.description: discomfort, difficulty in excessive weight bearing including activities such as prolonged standing and walking, particularly for walking up and down stairs; cannot stand on the right foot alone

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: Not suitable for vigorous sport activities; deprived of sporting activities that involved running, jumping or hopping
He could no longer perform the outdoor duties of his former job as a building supervisor and resigned, taking lower paid sedentary employment as a night-shift guard
20 per cent lower limb impairment which is equivalent to 8 per cent whole person impairment
